notes.title: Update Notes for 2024 Dec 8 (v1.1 Beta)
notes.content:
Update Notes
[list]
[*] Charge spheres can now pass through fences
[*] Added a new "total fence" tile/block type (under Props category in Editor) as charge spheres too easily collide with the solid bottom half of standard "window fence" blocks
[*] Rail gun, charge gun, and beam gun now use a separate "charge ammo" type instead of suit charge
[*] Added new "charge ammo" item pickup type
[*] Added new "charge ammo" supply locker (under Items category in Editor)
[*] Removed level designer credits from Campaign A and B
[*] Removed credits song
[*] Removed text messages from Survival and Versus modes
[*] Added 2 new Survival maps
[*] Added "charge ammo" supply lockers to Survival maps
[*] Using Survival upgrade vendors now pauses the game
[/list]

notes.title: Update Notes for Nov 9 (v0.50) and Clarifications
notes.content:
Patch Notes
[list]
[*] Removed slide puzzle from in-game computers
[*] Removed bottom drawers of file cabinets and storage cabinets
[*] Doubled number of file cabinets and storage cabinets
[*] Attempted fix on uncommon bug where force claw would be invisible on first pickup 
[/list]

Clarifications
[list]
[*] The playtest contains the entire game planned for initial launch
[*] Yes, this means testers are being given the entire game for free. This is to compensate them for their time spent testing and giving feedback.
[*] The playtest will close on November 19th on game launch
[*] Sign-ups for the playtest will close on November 12th
[*] Everyone signed up the time sign-ups close will eventually gain admission in the playtest before it closes
[*] If you are a tester and wish to receive a free copy of the main game in order to continue playing after the playtest closes, please reach out to our [url=mailto:contact.magentagrid@gmail.com]customer support[/url] (supply is limited, so testers only, please)
[*] Although the playtest currently includes a Mac version, testing has confirmed suspicions that the Mac version is unable to support all features included of the Windows version. Therefore, the final game will [b]NOT[/b] include a Mac version on initial launch. Mac support is [b]NOT[/b] guaranteed for the final product. Do [b]NOT[/b] purchase the game based on any expectation of a Mac version.
[/list]

notes.title: Update Notes for Nov 8 (v0.49)
notes.content:
[h3]Update Notes[/h3]
[list]
[*] Added musical cue to suit pick-up on e0m1 and e1m1
[*] Moved version numbering display from main menu to advanced options
[*] Sent out fifth waves of playtest admissions
[/list]

[h3]Reminder[/h3]
The game has recently announced a launch date of November 19, 2024. The play test will close when the game launches. If you want to play the entire game for free instead of buying the game, there is a little less than 2 weeks remaining.
